column1: # NightSeam supplement - objects OpenNGC cannot carry: the seven curated rows
# that had no OpenNGC counterpart. OpenNGC either lacks them (Abell 21,
# Jones-Emberson 1, Sh2-276, Mel 20) or classifies them as non-objects (IC 1318
# is typed '*' for gamma Cyg, M73 'Other', M40 '**'), so the OpenNGC pipeline
# drops them. Identity + astrometry are the project's own values from the
# catalogue carries no prose). scripts/build_adv_catalog.py appends this file to
# the OpenNGC rows and asserts id uniqueness across all three sources.

column15: mel20 | alpha persei cluster | mel 20, cr 39
ic1318 | IC 1318 | gamma cygni nebula (sadr region) | butterfly nebula
